column6: project-init's own dogfood of the tree it scaffolds: harnesses read .agents/ by name, and its names change with the template, together with an upgrade path for scaffolded repos
Claude Code reads .claude/ by name; it is the generated mirror of .agents/ (tools/sync_claude_dir.py)

the scaffold: every path here is a file name written into scaffolded repos, recorded in their .agents/.upgrade-base.json and wired in their settings and in harbor's admission (github_command_guard); renaming one needs an upgrade migration, not a rename
the marketplace payload: plugin ids (project-init-lifecycle, project-init-workflow) and skill names are what users install and type, and harbor's admission checks the plugin id
the import name of the PyPI package project-init, published on an index and pinned by users
Python import names are snake case; the package is project_init
Mermaid's own extension; the diagram skill and the staleness hooks read .mmd by name
GitHub reads CITATION.cff by name and upper case
